sources.title: OpenStax, Psychology §6.3 — operant conditioning, reinforcement and punishment, shaping, and the use of token economies
EBSCO Research Starters — systematic desensitisation: Wolpe's behaviour-therapy technique pairing graduated exposure with relaxation

visual.title: What each technique changes, and the ladder ethics requires
visual.alt: Anxiety plotted over time for systematic desensitisation, which stays low while the patient climbs a hierarchy in a relaxed state, against flooding, which produces one large spike that must be waited out; the three-term contingency with prompting and fading on the antecedent, shaping and chaining on the behaviour, and reinforcement, extinction and response cost on the consequence; a curve showing the extinction burst that precedes the decline; the token economy as a two-step exchange from target behaviour to token to backup reinforcer; and a ladder of least restrictive alternatives to be climbed from the bottom.
visual.caption: Two families of technique, one for each conditioning law: desensitisation and flooding re-pair a stimulus, while everything hung on the A-B-C spine re-arranges consequences. The burst is the moment most extinction programmes fail.
